description: Hi! I'm Pratanu Bhattacharyya, a college student passionate about technology, AI, coding, innovation, cricket, football, and gaming. I enjoy exploring new ideas, learning skills, and solving problems. I'm looking for creative, enthusiastic teammates interested in AI/ML, programming, web development, UI/UX design, and research. Beginners are welcome too! I value teamwork, dedication, creativity, and a willingness to learn. Let's collaborate, innovate, and build something amazing together!
